items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-23
items.q: I met Crunchy in the side screen show up in Virginia.

ctx.x: I think he got an old boy around there now. Bill my neighbor. Uh huh. Pick a little flutes and everything. Uh huh. Uh huh. Uh huh. Well, look in the other corner and see well, there's a shell sitting over there. Well I started on the page again on the shell. I grew up the shell. I started on the base power. I had to build one bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo…
Now that fellow man, always a hard worker. Crunchy used to be a hard worker too man. He was poor Crunchy. I met Crunchy in the side screen show up in Virginia. It changed the style you know. Oh yeah.
